name: mx-onboard
description: Makes a subsystem legible to a person, not to an agent. /explain writes an onboarding document whose pass condition is its surprises, then has a cold reviewer argue with it; /verify-doc reports which of one document's claims are still true; /survey audits every document in the repository in parallel and ranks them by what goes wrong if they are trusted; and a drift hook says so the moment an edit lands on a file a document describes.
